Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1303
Claimant:
Jacqueline Moody
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
19 Nov 2024
Claim received today for a side impact at an intersection involving the insured's vehicle and a second vehicle. The
claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will be routed through the attorney's office.
28 Nov 2024
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force on the date of loss. No issues with
the policy itself were found at intake.
22 Jan 2025
Otbained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the collision. Officers' observations
of the scene line up with the parties' descriptions.
2 Mar 2025
Reviewed scene photos and spoke with two independent witnesses, both of whom describe the accident the same
way the claimant and the other driver did. Their accounts are consistent on the sequence of events.
10 Mar 2025
Inspected the vehicle. The damage is mostly on the driver's side and is in line with the described impact. No earlier
damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or repair records.
18 Mar 2025
Claimant reported a concussion. The injury fits the kind and force of a side impact of this type, and the medical file
reflects a usual course of care that tapered as the patient improved.
25 Mar 2025
Medical history shows a minor strain in the same area several years ago, which healed fully with no ongoing
complaints. Noted for completeness and reviewed with the treating records.
13 Apr 2025
Claimant has given the same account in every conversation so far, including the iintial report, the recorded statement,
and the follow-up call with counsel present.
18 Apr 2025
Counsel has requested a copy of the claim file and the repair estimate. Sent both through the approved channel and
confirmed receipt.
26 Apr 2025
Nothing so far suggests the damage predates the coverage period. Claim remains open pending final medical review
and the repair invoice.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
